crons.comment: Stuck-render sweep. DAILY, not hourly: this account is on the Vercel Hobby plan, where any cron expression that would fire more than once a day fails the deployment outright. An hourly '0 * * * *' here is exactly what broke the 2026-08-07 deploy. Hobby also fires at any point inside the given hour, so treat 09:00 UTC as approximate. Change to hourly only after upgrading to Pro.
